description: Sample of h_bar(a, b, 1). Each entry is [a, b, [hv1, hv2, erreur_k, val, seconds]], as returned by h_bar: a and b are exact rationals, seconds is the computation time, and the four other values are real balls {mid, rad, prec}, where mid and rad are exact rationals and prec is the precision in bits. RealBallField(prec)(QQ(mid)).add_error(QQ(rad)) contains the ball that was stored.
